content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to create a momentary push button using cursor or function keys in [product_name]? Thanks.

In [product_name], cursor and function keys can only be used to display their status. However, you can simulate a push button using a digital value. For instance, create a digital variable (such as V0.0) and mark it as writable. In the software, use a digital network input and output both assigned to V0.0, along with a LOW block. This configuration will make V0.0 go HIGH for only one cycle, mimicking a momentary push button.
Refer to the attached file for further details.
